#!/bin/sh

case "${1}" in
start)
    export TSLIB_TSDEVICE=/dev/input/by-path/platform-e0005000.i2c-event
    export TSLIB_CONSOLEDEVICE=none
    export TSLIB_FBDEVICE=/dev/fb0

    export QT_QPA_FONTDIR=/usr/share/fonts
    export QT_QPA_PLATFORM=linuxfb:fb=/dev/fb0

    /opt/qt5/QMainApp >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    ;;
stop)
    for pid in `ps | grep apps | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1}'`
    do
        kill -9 ${pid}
    done

    for pid in `ps | grep QMainApp | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1}'`
    do
        kill -9 ${pid}
    done
    ;;
esac
files./etc/profile:
# /etc/profile: system-wide .profile file for the Bourne shell (sh(1))
# and Bourne compatible shells (bash(1), ksh(1), ash(1), ...).

PATH="/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
EDITOR="vi"			# needed for packages like cron, git-commit
[ "$TERM" ] || TERM="vt100"	# Basic terminal capab. For screen etc.

# Add /sbin & co to $PATH for the root user
[ "$HOME" != "/home/root" ] || PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/sbin:/sbin

# Set the prompt for bash and ash (no other shells known to be in use here)
[ -z "$PS1" ] || PS1='\u@\h:\w\$ '

if [ -d /etc/profile.d ]; then
	for i in /etc/profile.d/*.sh; do
		if [ -f $i -a -r $i ]; then
			. $i
		fi
	done
	unset i
fi

# Make sure we are on a serial console (i.e. the device used starts with
# /dev/tty[A-z]), otherwise we confuse e.g. the eclipse launcher which tries do
# use ssh
case $(tty 2>/dev/null) in
	/dev/tty[A-z]*) [ -x /usr/bin/resize ] && /usr/bin/resize >/dev/null;;
esac

export PATH PS1 OPIEDIR QPEDIR QTDIR EDITOR TERM

umask 022

umask 022

alias l='ls -lh'
alias ll='ls -alh'

export TSLIB_TSDEVICE=/dev/input/by-path/platform-e0005000.i2c-event
export TSLIB_CONSOLEDEVICE=none
export TSLIB_FBDEVICE=/dev/fb0
export TSLIB_CONFFILE=/etc/ts.conf
export TSLIB_PLUGINDIR=/usr/lib/ts

export QT_QPA_FONTDIR=/usr/share/fonts
export QT_QPA_PLATFORM=linuxfb:fb=/dev/fb0
